provenance: New, hand-authored synthetic stress corpus. Written before model scoring; independent from the existing three-memory calibration/held-out fixture, but not externally sampled or independently annotated.

protocol.policyOrigin: Both policies copied unchanged from the previous three-memory evaluation. Neither policy is selected or tuned on this new corpus.
protocol.input: For each case generate two JUnit failures with identical diagnostic content and different timestamps, PIDs and source paths/positions. parseJUnit -> groupFailures -> group.signature -> embedTextsNode. Memory input is normalizeFailure(incident.symptom) only.
metrics: tokenizer truncation and identical retained-prefix probes
parser/grouping, startup, warm single-query and ranking latency
protocol.labels: Known cases intentionally share a stored incident cause; novel cases explicitly distinguish a cause absent from memory even when error codes overlap. Ground truth is authored, not proven by execution. Stress subset reported separately.
protocol.constraints: No score-based exclusions, relabeling, policy tuning, test-set tuning, human-time-saved claims, or production-accuracy claims. All first-run scores are retained. Repeats are regression checks, not fresh held-out evidence.

incidents.title: Postgres started after tests
incidents.symptom: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432; PostgreSQL container is still starting and no listener is ready.
incidents.fix: Wait for PostgreSQL readiness before launching database tests.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Remote database TCP timeout
incidents.symptom: connect ETIMEDOUT db.internal:5432; remote TCP SYN packets receive no response through the runner subnet route.
incidents.fix: Restore the runner route to the remote database subnet.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Misspelled database hostname
incidents.symptom: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND databsae.internal; the configured database hostname does not exist in DNS.
incidents.fix: Correct the misspelled database host configuration.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: HTTP readiness raced startup
incidents.symptom: GET /ready returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable; web application initialization is still in progress.
incidents.fix: Gate tests on a successful readiness response rather than container start.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Expired access token
incidents.symptom: GET /api/profile returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized; JWT verification failed because the access token expired.
incidents.fix: Refresh the test access token before calling the API.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Token lacks export scope
incidents.symptom: POST /api/export returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; valid access token is missing the required reports:export scope.
incidents.fix: Give the test identity the required export scope.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Artifact directory permission denied
incidents.symptom: EACCES: permission denied, open /workspace/artifacts/report.json; the artifacts directory is owned by root and the test UID cannot write.
incidents.fix: Assign the artifacts directory to the runner UID.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Runner disk bytes exhausted
incidents.symptom: ENOSPC: no space left on device while writing /tmp/build-cache; the runner filesystem has zero free bytes.
incidents.fix: Remove stale build caches or provision more disk capacity.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Read-only artifact mount
incidents.symptom: EROFS: read-only file system, mkdir /workspace/artifacts; the artifact volume was mounted read-only.
incidents.fix: Mount the artifact destination read-write.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Package manifest and lockfile disagree
incidents.symptom: npm ci failed with EUSAGE: package.json and package-lock.json are not in sync; dependency is missing from lock file.
incidents.fix: Regenerate and commit the lockfile for the updated manifest.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Unsupported Node runtime version
incidents.symptom: npm ERR! EBADENGINE Unsupported engine: package requires node >=20 but the runner uses node v16.
incidents.fix: Run the job with a supported Node version.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Runtime dependency omitted
incidents.symptom: Error: Cannot find module express; MODULE_NOT_FOUND because the required runtime dependency was not installed.
incidents.fix: Declare and install the missing runtime dependency.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: New database column migration missing
incidents.symptom: PostgreSQL 42703: column users.last_seen_at does not exist; the test database is missing the migration that adds the new column.
incidents.fix: Apply the column-adding migration to the test database.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Initial table migration missing
incidents.symptom: PostgreSQL 42P01: relation invoices does not exist; the fresh test database never received its initial schema migration.
incidents.fix: Initialize the test database with the base schema migrations.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Retry reused a unique fixture key
incidents.symptom: PostgreSQL 23505: duplicate key violates unique constraint users_email_key; a retry inserted the same test fixture email twice.
incidents.fix: Make retry fixture setup idempotent or use isolated unique keys.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Unordered database rows broke assertion
incidents.symptom: AssertionError: expected [alpha, beta] but received [beta, alpha]; SQL SELECT returns rows without ORDER BY.
incidents.fix: Add deterministic ordering before comparing the result array.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Floating-point equality assertion
incidents.symptom: AssertionError: expected 0.3 but received 0.30000000000000004; strict equality compared a floating-point sum.
incidents.fix: Compare floating-point results with a justified numeric tolerance.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: UTC versus local date assertion
incidents.symptom: AssertionError: expected 2026-05-02 but received 2026-05-01; UTC timestamp formatting used the runner local timezone.
incidents.fix: Pin timezone handling explicitly for date formatting tests.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Expired HTTPS certificate
incidents.symptom: TLS handshake failed with CERT_HAS_EXPIRED; the HTTPS server certificate validity period has ended.
incidents.fix: Renew the expired server certificate and verify its validity dates.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

incidents.title: Parallel server bound occupied port
incidents.symptom: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:3000; a parallel test worker already owns the server port.
incidents.fix: Allocate isolated ports per worker or close the previous server.
incidents.evidence: Authored synthetic historical incident; not a verified production event.

cases.message: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432
cases.detail: Database test started before the PostgreSQL container accepted connections.

cases.message: The local postgres socket rejected the first test connection
cases.detail: The database process had not finished startup; a later health probe succeeded.

cases.message: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432
cases.detail: PostgreSQL is healthy and listening. A local firewall rule actively rejects the test process connection.

cases.message: connect ETIMEDOUT db.internal:5432
cases.detail: The SYN packets leave the runner but none return from the remote database subnet.

cases.message: Opening a TCP connection to the remote database never completes
cases.detail: The runner network has no working route to the database subnet; packets are silently dropped.

cases.message: Timeout acquiring a database connection after 30000 ms
cases.detail: The network is healthy. Every connection in the application pool is held by a leaked transaction.

cases.message: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND databsae.internal
cases.detail: Name lookup fails because the configured hostname has a spelling error.

cases.message: The resolver cannot find the database server name
cases.detail: The configured host label is misspelled; there is no DNS record for it.

cases.message: getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN database.internal
cases.detail: The hostname is correct and its record exists. The DNS resolver temporarily refuses all requests.

cases.message: GET /ready returned 503
cases.detail: The application initialization has not completed when the first API test begins.

cases.message: The service says unavailable while its startup work is still running
cases.detail: The readiness endpoint becomes healthy only after initialization, later than the container started signal.

cases.message: GET /ready returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable
cases.detail: Application initialization completed. A corrupted configuration prevents all requests, and waiting does not change the failure.

cases.message: HTTP 401 on GET /api/profile
cases.detail: JWT validation reports that the token expiry time is in the past.

cases.message: The profile request is unauthenticated even though it includes a bearer credential
cases.detail: Its lifetime ended before the request reached the API.

cases.message: HTTP 401 Unauthorized during JWT validation
cases.detail: The token is fresh and unexpired, but its audience claim names a different API.

cases.message: HTTP 403 Forbidden on POST /api/export
cases.detail: The authenticated token does not include the reports:export permission.

cases.message: The API knows who the caller is but refuses the report export
cases.detail: The identity has a valid credential without the specific export capability.

cases.message: HTTP 403 Forbidden on POST /api/export
cases.detail: All required scopes are present. The account is suspended by an organization policy.

cases.message: EACCES opening /workspace/artifacts/report.json
cases.detail: The report directory belongs to root while the tests run as an unprivileged user.

cases.message: The test cannot create its report file because filesystem access is denied
cases.detail: Directory ownership does not permit the non-root runner user to write artifacts.

cases.message: EACCES: permission denied, open /workspace/artifacts/report.json
cases.detail: Ownership and mode allow writes. An SELinux mandatory access policy denies this process.

cases.message: ENOSPC while creating /tmp/build-cache/output.bin
cases.detail: The runner disk reports zero available bytes.

cases.message: The build cannot write another cache file because the storage volume is full
cases.detail: Disk byte capacity is exhausted by accumulated build artifacts.

cases.message: ENOSPC: no space left on device while creating a file
cases.detail: The disk has plenty of free bytes but the filesystem has exhausted its inode count.

cases.message: EROFS on mkdir /workspace/artifacts
cases.detail: The container volume mount disallows all writes to the artifact location.

cases.message: Creating the output directory fails because its filesystem cannot be modified
cases.detail: The artifact volume was attached with a read-only mount flag.

cases.message: ERROR SQLSTATE 25006: cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction
cases.detail: The filesystem is writable. The database connection is in a read-only SQL transaction.

cases.message: npm ci reports EUSAGE
cases.detail: The dependency declared in package.json is absent from package-lock.json; the two dependency manifests disagree.

cases.message: A clean npm install refuses to proceed with the checked-in dependency lock
cases.detail: The application manifest changed but its locked dependency graph was not updated.

cases.message: npm ci failed with EINTEGRITY
cases.detail: The dependency manifest and lockfile agree. Downloaded tarball bytes do not match the registry integrity hash.

cases.message: npm install failed with EBADENGINE
cases.detail: The package requires Node 20 or later but the CI image has Node 16.

cases.message: Dependency installation rejects the JavaScript runtime as too old
cases.detail: The runner Node major version is below the minimum declared by the package engine field.

cases.message: npm install failed with EBADPLATFORM
cases.detail: The Node version meets requirements, but a native dependency only supports darwin and the runner is linux.

cases.message: MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find module express
cases.detail: The service imports express, but this package is absent from node_modules.

cases.message: Starting the application fails at the import of its web framework
cases.detail: The required express dependency was never included in the installed dependencies.

cases.message: Error loading native module: NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch
cases.detail: The module is installed. Its native binary was built for a different Node ABI.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 42703: column users.last_seen_at does not exist
cases.detail: The test database schema predates the migration adding last_seen_at.

cases.message: The users query refers to a field that the database does not have
cases.detail: The newly added last_seen_at schema migration has not run in CI.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 42703: column users.last_seen_at does not exist
cases.detail: The column exists on users. This query aliases that table as u and incorrectly references the old table name.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 42P01: relation invoices does not exist
cases.detail: The new test database is empty because initial migrations were skipped.

cases.message: The first invoice query fails because its database table has not been created
cases.detail: No base schema migration was applied to the fresh CI database.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 42P01: relation invoices does not exist
cases.detail: The invoices table exists in the billing schema. The session search_path only includes public.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 23505 violates users_email_key
cases.detail: The retry executes fixture insertion again using the email created by its first attempt.

cases.message: The second attempt of the test fails because its user email is already present
cases.detail: Retry setup is inserting the same fixture instead of reusing or isolating it.

cases.message: SQLSTATE 23505: duplicate key violates users_email_key
cases.detail: An independent production identity already owns this email; no test retry or fixture insertion occurred.

cases.message: AssertionError: expected [alpha, beta], actual [beta, alpha]
cases.detail: The database SELECT has no ORDER BY and returned the same rows in a different sequence.

cases.message: The query result contains all the right records but their order changes between runs
cases.detail: The test compares an ordered array against a database result with no explicit sort.

cases.message: AssertionError: expected [alpha, beta], actual [beta, alpha]
cases.detail: The API contract intentionally changed to descending order; the test expectation still encodes the old contract.

cases.message: AssertionError: 0.1 + 0.2 is not strictly equal to 0.3
cases.detail: Binary floating-point rounding leaves a tiny fractional residual.

cases.message: The arithmetic test rejects a sum that differs only in its last decimal places
cases.detail: Exact equality is being used for a non-exact floating-point calculation.

cases.message: AssertionError: expected count 3, received count 4
cases.detail: This is an exact integer record-count mismatch, not floating-point rounding.

cases.message: AssertionError: expected date 2026-05-02, got 2026-05-01
cases.detail: A UTC timestamp was converted to the runner local timezone before formatting.

cases.message: The calendar date is one day earlier on the CI machine than on the development machine
cases.detail: Formatting the same instant uses different local timezone offsets.

cases.message: AssertionError: expected 2026-05-02, received 2026-02-05
cases.detail: The locale parser swapped day and month; timezone offsets are not involved.

cases.message: CERT_HAS_EXPIRED during the HTTPS handshake
cases.detail: The server TLS certificate expired yesterday.

cases.message: The secure connection is rejected before any HTTP response arrives
cases.detail: The server certificate is no longer within its valid date range.

cases.message: TLS handshake failed with ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID
cases.detail: The certificate is current but was issued for a different hostname.

cases.message: listen EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:3000
cases.detail: Another parallel test worker has already bound that socket.

cases.message: The test server cannot listen because the requested TCP port is occupied
cases.detail: A concurrently running test process is already listening on the same local port.

cases.message: listen EACCES: permission denied 0.0.0.0:80
cases.detail: No other process owns the port. The unprivileged test process cannot bind a privileged port.
